items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: We used to play for all those... Celeste and told me... I said, the dog, anything you want to play, it's all right with me.

ctx.x: We used to play for all those, in other words, every time they had a funeral like the Swell or the Archfellas and the Pithes, they used to bury it with music then. And so we went and we were playing at the Girard Street Cemetery, you see? And when we were coming out, Celeste and told me, he said, I used to call him the dog, you see, that's what I used to call Celeste. He said, well, Charles, what do you think if we play? I said, the dog, anything you want to play, it's all right with me. I said, look, because…
